description: JSON-shaped return specification, not a model invocation. Implementer may encode as a schema.

patches.old_text: exact text from base version; empty only for reserved insertion

checks.evidence: span ID, observed count or explanation; never unsupported assertion

repair_requests.reason: why current pass cannot fix safely

blocked_questions: minimal necessary missing fact or decision
references_used: source ID + exact range or paragraph ID

patch_application: Reject stale base version; refresh affected context and re-propose.
Check old_text matches target span exactly.
Reject overlapping patches or undeclared writable scope.
Preview or use explicit app-authorized edit workflow; preserve undo and user edits.
readiness_policy: Only final_flow may set ready_for_review; every applicable rule must pass, no failed or blocked checks, no unresolved required facts/conflicts, no stale patches, and current script version must equal checked version. not_applicable always needs a reason. Other passes return not_assessed. Any unresolved dirty check also prevents readiness.
